title: Kapil Sharma's AWESOME rapid fire on SRK, Karan Johar, Priyanka Chopra, his famous tweets & more
description: Kapil Sharma in exclusive interview with Bollywood Hungama. Kapil in this fun segment answers some quirky rapid fire questions. He reveals his fashion icon and opens up on tweets that he regrets. He also reveals what he will do if wakes up as Karan Johar, Priyanka Chopra, Anushka Sharma, Aamir Khan and Shah Rukh Khan. Must Watch!    Watch more Exclusive Celebrity Interviews right here http://www.bollywoodhungama.com/  Like BollywoodHungama on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/bollywoodhungamacom  Follow BollywoodHungama on Twitter: https://twitter.com/Bollyhungama  Circle BollywoodHungama on G+: http://bit.ly/1uV6Qba

asr.full_text: Any Tweet that you have done and that you regret? So many, I've written many... normally I'm a human being if I can feel anything I write it down. Who's your fashion icon? I have a lot of confidence in Shahrukh bhai, his clothes... Karan Johar. I'll get up soon and launch someone... Anushka Sharma. I will go out to enjoy stardom Hi, this is Kapil Sharma and you're watching me on Bollywood Hangama Keep watching Sir, we also have a rapid fire with you So, we'll just play a rapid fire with you as well So, a rapid fire with Kapil Sharma your first reaction upon hearing the script of Firangi? I can't think of my first reactions because I didn't make the script. It was made really slowly in my hands, So it was a jump, that during this period we will do this, it will have a story and an adventure story... ...so I saw this story made for me... ...I saw it made and it was so good that I was ecstatic... ...this is great as it might seem like a period film before... ...on but we will not touch the dark side here. In this film we will keep a little jokes and romance. Yes. I was excited so this was Jermaiat and I was excited for it. The story started making with the team it took a year or 1.5 years. That's why the reaction after the script and the stories. Okay a recent film that you saw? I saw a newton, I liked it, it is about election, it is serious, he is very sincere and I liked it even the small nuances. I liked the dance move a lot. I don't remember a lot. If I take names I'll remember. Any tweet and you've liked it. So many I feel like you've done and you've degraded. I feel that I'm a person if I can write anything. Suddenly the same thing that I said earlier I forget if with me if in future I'll say something about this again Sometimes when I go on Twitter when I'm fresh after take a bath and I become fresh. I'm not tired of shooting since I came back after the pack up and I'm also in a new mood. so I don't go on Twitter now. So any one that you say that you regret? I think I never did anything wrong. Wrong in the sense that yeah the method can be wrong too. That you can do anything for somebody else. But yeah. I wasn't wrong. I've never lied. Okay we agree with that. We agree with that we understand what you mean. or do something for someone... But yes, I wasn't wrong... I never lie Okay we agree that we understand... what you mean? Okay, who is your fashion icon? I think Shahrukh brothers is very much class His clothes is very nice Ranvir those are very nice Right because I wear whatever I have in my hand It means that he likes them but yes The clothes I have to the person in mine so I wear what I get. I mean they like them, that's why. Have you fallen in love with a fish? Many times... but here we haven't fallen in love it's... People come and like us a we go out on a trip, A lot of times that happens, we have a crew with us. We become friends with people. But never did we fall in love. Okay. Who is the funniest person that you know? My mom? Okay. She is very funny. Alright. First thought that comes to your mind when we just take the names of following comedians, Johnny Lever. He doesn't needs a script, he can make you laugh with his expression only. Sanjay Mishra. Very good actor. He is a very good actor. Johnny Walker. I have seen one or two movies of Mr. Johnny Walker, but I've definitely seen many films of that guy he's very old But I like his films as much as I've seen the ones he made Okay Charlie Chaplin I like him a lot even though I haven't seen English movies But all the movies I saw The ones with scenes I liked The videos that we saw on TV as which they used to bring to the TV as a child, that was a lot of fun to watch I also watched his movies, The Dictator he was a very good actor actually Absolutely We call him a comedian, but he was a fantastic actor Right Mehmood Sir Mehmood was multi-talhmood saab was a multitalented individual, As much as we heard about you We were shooting a scene with Salman Bhai yesterday when he was telling us a story That he used to be an assistant who was with Jony Vawker Oh okay Yeah and I didn't know about this So he said they used to stand behind him saying that you can do this and that But once he came out of the scene, then the thing was that a chance and when they come I would believe that the hero is Maimood Sahab. So, they are great! How about Omar Sharif? Omar is very talented, in our Pakistani show, when I came for Laugh-ter-Challenge, he was our special episode judge in that finale. Right. One-liners from him are also very good. By a certain extent was Kapil Sharma's shows more inspired by his stage shows? No, not at all! Like Bakra Khiston Pe Hai and then..? No! When we were in America, we used to do theatre for comedy. So, we had been in drama for many years. So, drama... ...which we now call a stage play... ...has been going on for centuries. It started with comedy, then, people used to make it Serious. In Comedian we've started making skits, we didn't make a play till date. It was a two to one hour play, we did small skits. But, yes people do say that sometimes the show is fine. Today if I say that I'm starting a family drama with a stage audience I can't tell that other shows will be doing it too. So I can't say maybe they will be inspired by it... ... but I can't say they will be copying it. Okay what will you do if you wake up as Karan Johar? I will wake up and I will launch someone also! What will you do if you wake up as Priyanka Chopra? First I will catch a flight flight and I visit there... ...she lives quite a bit outside... Okay. And what will you do when you wake up as Anushka Sharma? That was definitely a coffee breaking moment... ...I got confused and said if I come out I look like Anushka Sharma... And this will look really good on me... ...I will enjoy, I will feel very good. I will step out, start up or enjoy Ok, what will you do if you wake up as Amir Khan Then I will go to sleep Because I just want to make one sub film per year, so I will get up and think about tomorrow What will you do if you wake up as Shah Rukh Khan Shah Rukh Khan, I will wake up and be like, Oh I as Shah Rukh Khan? Shah Rukh Khan? I usually wake up by saying, I am Shah Rukh Khan. Even I asked this question. Everyone says. I think you wake up in the morning and for a mere moment. And when you watch in the mirror, you tell yourself that Shah Rukh Khan is me. And I ask that how you feel. He says, It is a good thing he is me. ...I say I only? And she says I don't really know how to relate! Hi! this is Kapil Sharma, and you're watching me on Bollywood Hangama! Keep watching!
